newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse bounces back, BUX futures rise.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse bounces back, BUX futures rise.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed higher on Monday, reversing last week's steep falls, but leaving traders divided about the reason.
The BUX index closed at 5,081.57 points, up 89.12.
"The market reflected some optimism as it recovered," one trader said. "Share prices fell to levels which inspired the imagination of potential buyers."
BUX futures closed higher for all maturities, by between 57.5 and 216.5 points. March BUX ended at 5,111.5, up 57.5.

While this trader said the market might expect slow but continuous rise in the coming days, another dealer was less optimistic and said the rise was an upward correction following last week's steep falls and was unlikely to last long.
"Last week the market plunged seven percent so I think we can face an upward correction on the first two days of the week," one trader said earlier.
"We may continue to rise tomorrow as the fall was too sharp but I can imagine the market to fall again later."
Traders said a positive week close on Wall Street gave some extra help to the market, but the dollar's weakening against the Hungarian currency virtually offset this advantage.

On Monday, chemicals Borsodchem had the highest volume with more than 263,000 shares, but this amount included a huge deal for 175,000 shares at 6,000 forints/share price. Borsodchem closed at 5,995 forints, up 45.
Elsewhere, the market's other chemicals issue, TVK firmed by six and a half percent or 125 forints to end at 2,070.
All the three pharmaceuticals were heavy gainers.
Human, which said today it plans to pay 20 percent of its 1996 profits for dividends, surged almost eight percent or 220 forints to close at 3,000.
Egis, rated by CS First Boston as 'buy', gained 305 forints to end at 9,755, Richter firmed 240 forints to end at 11,100.
Elsewhere on the market retailer Csopak closed steady at 3,100 forints after K&H Securities downgraded it to 'hold' from 'buy.'
